contractNotActive.summary: Active medication contract is not enabled

staleBase.summary: A command used a stale base revision

error.message: The resource changed; refresh and rebase the command

ApiError.description: Versioned safe API error; correlationId is included and details are code-allowlisted.

X-Correlation-Id.description: Request correlation identifier shared with the error body.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Medication contracts include CONTRACT_NOT_ACTIVE, MEDICATION_BRIDGE_REQUIRED, MEDICATION_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, CONFLICT_STALE_UPDATE, MISS_NOT_ALLOWED (422), and CLIENT_UPGRADE_REQUIRED.

parentPill.description: Response-only complete canonical medication for bridge v3, including deleted ancestors.

parentProfile.description: Response-only complete canonical person for bridge v3, verified to the authenticated owner.

parentSchedule.description: Response-only historical parent for bridge v2/v3. In v3 all three ancestor snapshots are present together or absent together.

BridgePrnCommandV1.description: Inactive-ledger PRN take/undo. It creates no inventory event and never converts an administration amount into stock.

bridgeUndo.description: Additive: bridge medication commands accept status pending (undo of a dose).

emailReset.description: Additive: whether this server emails password reset links (the effective reset mode is email and SMTP is configured). Carries nothing about any account or about delivery failures.

latestClientBuild.description: Additive: app build of the newest published release. Present with latestServerVersion.

latestReleaseUrl.description: Additive: release page of the newest published release. Present with latestServerVersion.

latestServerVersion.description: Additive: newest published release version. Present only after a successful daily update check.

ledgerPrn.description: Additive: the PRN command route accepts take and undo after ledger activation and applies their stock effect.

medicationLedgerActive.description: Dynamic database authority state; not an image setting.

minimumClientBuild.description: Dynamic enforced minimum. The artifact target is intentionally not exposed.

recordedMiss.description: Additive: the medication ledger accepts the miss action and the missed occurrence state (medicationCommands 3).

EmailStatusV1.description: Aggregates only: no recipients, message contents or error text. Failures cover the last seven days; the last timestamp is the most recent permanent failure at any time.

MedicationBridgeCommandV1.description: Atomic inactive-ledger bridge mutation for a legacy dose and any corresponding inventory delta. It is rejected once the active v2 ledger is authoritative.

status.description: pending soft-deletes the dose (undo); advertised by the bridgeUndo capability.

MedicationBridgeSyncSnapshotV1.description: Finite read-only bridge snapshot. It never authorizes a write and is reconciled through the permanent checkpoint endpoint before active-ledger v2 writes.

MedicationCommandV2.description: Active-ledger command (medicationCommands 2 and 3). Retrying a commandId returns its permanent receipt; stale commands are rebased with a new linked command rather than mutating the original. The miss action (medicationCommands 3) records pending to missed for an exact, expected scheduled occurrence whose planned time has passed by at least one minute (the smallest delay the app allows, less a 30 second clock tolerance): it forbids targetState, reversesEventId, rebasesCommandId, actualAt and note, returns 422 MISS_NOT_ALLOWED when the occurrence is not eligible and 409 CONFLICT_STALE_UPDATE when it is no longer pending.

occurrenceKey.description: Stable occurrence locator, independent of schedule edits.

targetState.description: Required only for correct. missed is reachable only through the miss action.

ResetLinkIssuedV1.description: Returned once, with Cache-Control no-store. The token is never stored in plain text or written to the audit log.

passwordResetMode.description: Stored choice; null means automatic (email when SMTP is configured, otherwise manual).

UpdateServerSettingsV1.description: Omitted fields stay unchanged. Selecting email while SMTP is not configured returns 409 ADMIN_EMAIL_RESET_UNAVAILABLE.

info.description: Versioned API contracts. Successful v1 bodies remain route-specific and are never globally wrapped. GET /api/v1/capabilities publishes dynamic activation and enforced minimum build. Only explicitly marked authenticated mutations are build-gated; missing X-Simpastil-Client-Build means build 1. Clients must not select a legacy write path when capability discovery fails.
